name: council-dial-lite
description: The lighter, script-free edition of Council Dial. Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose (specialised or generalist reviewers; judged, with an appeal of the judge's dismissals, pooled or consensus combining; optional debate, sequential and baseline runs), has each agent save its own report, copies the findings word for word into a summary that a fresh agent checks against the reports, and logs each run in your project. Claude does every step itself, with no script, so the log has none of the script's checks; for research runs, use the full Council Dial: https://github.com/Ablation-Lab/council-dial. Claude writes only inside reviews/lite/ in your project, or another folder you choose inside it (and the subagents may write scratch files in temporary folders); Lite adds no server, network request or telemetry of its own.
